SubLayerProcessing.SQLScript: WITH THIS AS (SELECT ds.HCCNumber AS hcc_code, ds.HCCDescription AS hcc_description, ds.HCCVersion AS hcc_model_version, ds.HCCType AS hcc_model_type, ds.IsChronic AS is_chronic_condition, ey.EffectiveYear AS effective_year, ey.EffectiveDateStart AS effective_start_date, ey.EffectiveDateEnd AS effective_end_date, hash(concat(IfNull(ds.HCCNumber, '|'), '|', IfNull(ds.HCCDescription, '|'), '|', IfNull(ds.HCCVersion, '|'), '|', IfNull(ds.HCCType, '|'), '|', IfNull(ds.IsChronic, false), '|', IfNull(ey.EffectiveYear, '|'), '|', IfNull(ey.EffectiveDateStart, '|'), '|', IfNull(ey.EffectiveDateEnd, '|'))) AS hash_key, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY IfNull(ds.HCCNumber, '|'), IfNull(ds.HCCVersion, '|'), IfNull(ds.HCCType, '|'), IfNull(ey.EffectiveYear, '|') ORDER BY IfNull(ds.CreationDatetime, '9999-12-31') DESC) AS RowNumber FROM HCCDataSet ds LEFT JOIN HCCEffectiveYear ey ON ds.HCCEffectiveYearID = ey.HCCEffectiveYearID) SELECT hcc_code, hcc_description, hcc_model_version, hcc_model_type, is_chronic_condition, effective_year, effective_start_date, effective_end_date, hash_key FROM THIS WHERE RowNumber = 1
SubLayerProcessing.MergeScript: MERGE INTO claimsprocessing.silver.silver_hcc t USING (SELECT * FROM tempSQLScript) s ON IfNull(s.hcc_code,'|') = IfNull(t.hcc_code,'|') AND IfNull(s.effective_year,'|') = IfNull(t.effective_year,'|') AND IfNull(s.hcc_model_version,'|') = IfNull(t.hcc_model_version,'|') AND IfNull(s.hcc_model_type,'|') = IfNull(t.hcc_model_type,'|') WHEN MATCHED AND t.hash_key <> s.hash_key THEN UPDATE SET hcc_code = s.hcc_code, hcc_description = s.hcc_description, hcc_model_version = s.hcc_model_version, hcc_model_type = s.hcc_model_type, is_chronic_condition = s.is_chronic_condition, effective_year = s.effective_year, effective_start_date = s.effective_start_date, effective_end_date = s.effective_end_date, hash_key = s.hash_key WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (hcc_code, hcc_description, hcc_model_version, hcc_model_type, is_chronic_condition, effective_year, effective_start_date, effective_end_date, hash_key) VALUES (s.hcc_code, s.hcc_description, s.hcc_model_version, s.hcc_model_type, s.is_chronic_condition, s.effective_year, s.effective_start_date, s.effective_end_date, s.hash_key)
